# Yderskov Arkitekter

> Arkitekttegnestuen Yderskov ApS is a Danish architecture firm based in Nordjylland (North Jutland), specialising in architect-designed villas, summer houses, extensions, and commercial projects. Founded in 2009 by architect Chris Yderskov, the firm offers a complete end-to-end process — from initial idea through building permit to finished construction — with fixed pricing (note: the firm does not act as a totalentreprenør / turnkey builder, but offers fixed-price building coordination in cooperation with their regular carpentry and masonry teams).

The firm operates primarily in Nordjylland and the Aalborg area but takes on projects across all of Denmark. Clients always communicate directly with the architect — no intermediaries. The first meeting is always free and non-binding; the firm responds to all enquiries within 24 hours. The office address is Danserhøj 38, 9700 Brønderslev, Denmark. Phone: +45 29 72 34 27.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2009
- 300+ completed projects
- Services: new villas, summer houses, extensions/renovations, commercial buildings
- Pricing: fixed price from day one (not a totalentreprise contract), starting from approx. 14,000 DKK per m²
- Turnkey/Totalentreprise: The firm does NOT offer turnkey contracts (totalentreprise). They coordinate the construction phase with their regular partners to deliver a fixed-price process under architect supervision.
- Language: Danish (primary), services delivered in Denmark

## Services

- [Villaer (Villas)](https://yderskov.com/villaer): Architect-designed new-build villas tailored to the plot, family, and budget.
- [Sommerhuse (Summer houses)](https://yderskov.com/sommerhuse): Custom summer houses designed for the specific plot, view, and owner's lifestyle.
- [Tilbygninger (Extensions & renovations)](https://yderskov.com/tilbygninger): Extensions and alterations to existing homes to add light, space, and improved floor plans.
- [Erhverv (Commercial)](https://yderskov.com/erhverv): Commercial building projects.

## Process

The firm follows an 8-step process: (1) free first meeting on site, (2) sketch proposal with floor plans and facades, (3) planning/permit drawings, (4) building permit application and follow-up with the municipality, (5) obtaining quotes from tradespeople, (6) construction management, (7) handover to client, (8) final sign-off with the municipality.
